posts.text:
Democrat strategist Alencia Johnson was spinning wildly on CNN, accusing President Trump of taking away the voting rights of black Americans.

Scott Jennings didn’t interrupt her. Instead, he waited for her to finish.

When he entered the fray, he asked the one question that unraveled her entire narrative: “How?”

JOHNSON: “He is actually championing a bill that actually would take voting rights away from a lot of black people in this country, all during black history month, and then call the president the first black president and the first lady monkeys and apes in this during this month.”

“So this doesn’t absolve Donald Trump of his racism. We all know exactly who he is. The reality is the conversation, and the question should be, why do people continue to support him if they don’t want us to believe they are okay with racism?”

JENNINGS: “Wait, what voting rights is he taking away from black voters?”

JOHNSON: “The SAVE Act! That’s exactly what we’re talking about.”

JENNINGS: “How?”

JOHNSON: “That is actually going to disenfranchise overwhelmingly a lot of people of color.”

JENNINGS: “How? How?”

JOHNSON: “There are so many civil rights organizations that have run the data. If you look at the way it is going to disenfranchise black voters—”

JENNINGS: “How?”

JOHNSON: “It’s the same reason Chuck Schumer called it Jim Crow 2.0.”

JENNINGS: “How? You haven’t said how yet!”

JOHNSON: “I am talking about it. It’s the way that you’re putting new poll taxes on us.”

JENNINGS: “Poll taxes?!”

JOHNSON: “If you want to say that people have to prove that they are citizens, that they have to prove with a voter ID, the reality is you’re layering what is a constitutional right for the American people and making it harder for people to vote in this country, and it’s going to disenfranchise black voters.”

That’s when @ScottJenningsKY landed his knockout blow.

JENNINGS: “Does it concern you that you’re making all these claims you’ve yet to lay out how it’s hurting anyone.”

“But 76% of black voters think we should show an ID to vote. 80% of hispanic voters, 83% of the American people.”

“Are you saying that black voters are too dumb to know what’s good for them?”

“I mean, it sounds pretty condescending to me.”

→ The human role shifts from coding and tweaking to designing tests and success criteria

posts.text:
[WEVERSE] Taehyung weverse post  

🐯: Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving us such a meaningful award. ❤️

Every time we receive an award, it makes us realise once again that the love we receive is never something we should take for granted. You gave us such wonderful awards at the MMA, almost like presents, so we went and had pizza after finishing our schedule today.

As the end of the year approaches, we know that there are many of you looking forward to and anticipating our year-end performances. I’ve noticed there are so many posts about the year-end award shows on Weverse. We know that those feelings come from such a place of love, and we’re always so grateful for that!

However, this year, we’re on our ARIRANG tour.

There are ARMYs in so many different countries who have been waiting a long time to see us. For some, this concert might be their first time seeing us in 10 years, while for others, it might be a moment they’ve waited 13 years for.

When we’re performing, sometimes we get to read the slogans and messages ARMYs are holding up.

“Let’s meet again after 7 years!” “Thank you for coming to our country after 10 years.” “I came all the way to this country just to see BTS!”

Every time I read things like that, it really makes me think. A day that might be just one of many concerts for us can be a day that someone has been counting down to for years. That really touches my heart.

Of course! Year-end performances are incredibly precious to us too. But with so many award ceremonies and stages taking place, it’s difficult to participate in just one without having to think carefully about it. And properly preparing for each performance takes more time and effort than you might expect.

We’d definitely do a great job if we performed! But this year, more than anything, we wanted to meet the ARMYs who have been waiting for us for such a long time and devote ourselves a little more fully to spending time with them.

This decision was absolutely not about whose wait was longer or whose feelings mattered more. If anything, it’s because everyone’s anticipation and love are precious to us that we want to give our very best to the things we can do right now.

For the ARMYs who were looking forward to seeing us perform at the year-end shows, this might be a slightly disappointing year. But please know that we haven’t forgotten those feelings either. (🤙🏽)

I’d like you to think of this year’s end as a time when we’re going around meeting, one by one, all those people who have waited for us for so long.

For the ARMYs who won’t be able to attend our concerts, I imagine it must feel really disappointing. I’ve been trying to film various things whenever I get a little free time because I’ve been thinking about you, but I’m not sure if it’ll be enough.

I’ll also put our heads together with the members and think about how we can make even those of you who are far away feel happy!

Got it??

Our hearts haven’t grown smaller, okay? And please don’t say that we’ve become distant or that we seem far away just because we’re world stars now.

We can even take pictures of ourselves picking our noses, you know? So don’t worry, okay?

I just ate pizza and now I’m sleepy. I’m going to bed.

Goodnight! Thank you for giving us so much love. We love you just as much, too. 💜
